name: mcp-call
description: Client-side MCP bridge: list and call tools, list and read resources on other MCP servers over stdio. Servers come from an mcp.json config (Claude Code shape); each call is an ephemeral session.
use_when: calling tools on other MCP servers — email, DB, or any MCP connector

args.name: servers
args.description: List configured servers (command/args/env key names, never values).

args.name: tools <server>
args.description: List the server's tools with names/descriptions/schemas.

args.name: call <server> <tool> [--args JSON]
args.description: Call a tool; --args is a JSON object, default {}.

args.name: read <server> <uri>
args.description: Read a resource; returns its content blocks.

stdout: JSON — server list, tool list, call result {isError, content[]}, or resource contents.
